verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a hosted and API-based off-ramp in which the user picks the crypto, fiat currency and amount, then selects a payout method. Marketing copy says users get paid straight to a bank account or Visa card, and a sell-requote webhook supports the flow. However, the evidence never publishes the supported currencies or countries, never addresses stablecoins specifically, and only shows user-initiated sells, not business-directed payouts to recipients. Missing for 10: a published list of supported fiat currencies and countries, stablecoin-specific off-ramp documentation, details on bank-transfer rails (e.g. SEPA, ACH, wires), a payout-to-recipient flow, and independent corroboration.
